recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. A future fully self-hosted search feature, if desired, should be handled as a new site-platform decision rather than as unfinished FHIR-3532 work.
issue_request: FHIR-3532 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking to address slow page loading and unavailable "Search the FHIR Specification" behavior caused by Google being blocked in some countries/regions; comments record that an inbuilt search was needed and applied in svn revision 7140 for DSTU1.
initial_application: Git commit 35b5a246572b0888bd84c0c8b89efe522e5bfd3b, subject "#3532 - search related changes" and git-svn-id build@7140, applied the issue by replacing the navbar Google-search placeholder with search header/footer generation that linked to http://hl7.org/fhir/search.cfm.
additional_context: Historical WebMaker source loaded http://www.google.com/jsapi and Google CustomSearchControl, identifying the obsolete dependency. Current templates use [%search-location%] for header/footer/home-page search links, and the active search-build.html page is listed in publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml and uses DuckDuckGo rather than Google Custom Search. No relevant Zulip or Confluence records were found that would change this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current in-scope source already avoids the Google Custom Search page-load dependency targeted by FHIR-3532; remaining Google references are unrelated examples/references or inert CSS selectors.
